companyName.title: Company / business name
companyName.description: A single registered business name (or part of one) to search for in the PACRA registry, e.g. "Zambia Sugar" or "MTN". The live site recommends at least 4 characters for a meaningful match.

companyNames.title: Company / business names
companyNames.description: Multiple business names to search for in one run -- each string runs as a separate search query, up to 50 matching entities returned per query (a server-side cap, not adjustable).

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many search queries to run in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Off by default -- no anti-bot protection (WAF/CAPTCHA) was found on this target's public search API, so a direct connection works reliably. Turn on if you run a very high query volume.
